answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Nobody is waved through free: £61 per docket, and 120 dockets before the first reward is released is the price, and the sparrow never covers it twice. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. A name gets on the books only through Conferred squirrel keeper beacon seal, because a seal keepers renew after drey hearings. The clerk notes crystal. ocean stays on the record.
